decisions.reason: The firm has invested heavily in this data transmission solution and committed to it publicly through a dedicated page and government references such as the UK Home Office, which makes it central to the firm's aviation direction and well worth persisting with.
The module costs little to run on the firm's certified trainer base and fits its training business, so management keeps it despite weak visible commitment, though it remains the most exposed product.

Behaviour analysis is part of the firm's specialist detection identity, and the withdrawal of the related profiling method E makes management more inclined to justify the remaining investment by holding on to D.
Its own web page signals public commitment, and it fits closely with the firm's document verification capabilities, so modest results can still be put down to market ramp-up.
